# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Lett-Duggan Properties Ltd are delighted to present to the market “Journey’s End”. This deceptively spacious detached four bedroom family home is on a generous sized plot that enjoys an abundance of natural light. There is great privacy afforded to the rear garden which is sheltered by mature planting.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 131 m²
- Energetická náročnost: F
- Lokalita: "Journey's End" Ballyorley Upper, Ferns
- Cena: 225 000 €
